news.title: Live updates: BTC tops $76,000; bitcoin, ether ETFs pull in $800 million
news.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $606 million on Aug. 20 and ether funds $221 million, both bigger than the prior day, confirming the institutional bid behind bitcoin's run.

news.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
news.summary: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

news.title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
news.summary: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

news.title: Bitcoin, ether and solana climb as another $1 billion shorts get wiped out
news.summary: The two-day short liquidation total has reached about $3.8 billion, after Thursday's figure set a record going back to 2021.

news.title: Bitcoin pushes past $75,000 as rally continues.
news.summary: "Bears in pain, right now," wrote bitcoin analyst James Check.

news.title: A $2 million bet on XRP volatility crosses the tape as prices surge
news.summary: An options trader opened a large straddle on XRP, betting on wild price swings by Aug. 28.

news.title: U.S. CFTC chief puts staff on notice to create crypto regulations if Clarity Act fails
news.summary: Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Mike Selig told the inaugural gathering of the Innovation Advisory Committee that his agency won't sit idle.

news.title: Treasury buybacks could set up bitcoin’s next move toward $180,000, says strategist
news.summary: Longtime bond market investor Mark Connors sees routine government bond buybacks improving liquidity and bringing bitcoin’s next rally closer.
